## Problem

Describe the defect or approved need, with reproduction steps.

## Change

Explain the resulting behavior and why these changes belong together.

## Scope

Link the maintainer-approved proposal for new features/behavior changes, or explain why this is a small, obvious fix.

## Verification

List relevant tests, observed results, and anything untested. For UI/gesture changes include screenshots or a short recording, plus macOS and source/destination app versions. Remove private content from evidence.
